# Evaluation report

**DGCNN mIoU 0.996 against 0.929 for gradient boosting on handcrafted features**, on 12 held-out streets (104,469 points each on average). Generated by `ltw evaluate`.

## Segmentation (intersection over union)

| Condition | Model | mIoU | Accuracy | ground | building | vegetation | pole | vehicle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| test | DGCNN | **0.996** | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.997 | 0.987 | 0.998 | 1.000 |
| test | gradient boosting | **0.929** | 0.976 | 1.000 | 0.947 | 0.949 | 0.872 | 0.874 |
| half density | DGCNN | **0.994** | 0.998 | 0.999 | 0.996 | 0.983 | 0.995 | 0.999 |
| half density | gradient boosting | **0.856** | 0.961 | 0.999 | 0.931 | 0.868 | 0.639 | 0.841 |
| noisy (5 cm) | DGCNN | **0.994** | 0.998 | 0.999 | 0.996 | 0.982 | 0.995 | 0.999 |
| noisy (5 cm) | gradient boosting | **0.684** | 0.864 | 0.990 | 0.707 | 0.702 | 0.457 | 0.566 |
| taller buildings | DGCNN | **0.994** | 0.998 | 0.999 | 0.997 | 0.981 | 0.995 | 0.999 |
| taller buildings | gradient boosting | **0.931** | 0.979 | 1.000 | 0.961 | 0.948 | 0.868 | 0.877 |

The conditions are scans the model never trained on: the held-out streets as generated, the same streets with half the points, with 5 cm instead of 1.5 cm range noise, and with buildings taller than any in training (14 to 30 m, against 6 to 18 m).

Inference: 59.4 s per street on 2 CPU cores, two passes voting (one pass under the other conditions and for the change pairs).

## Twin: assets against the registry

| Asset | In registry | Detected | Matched | Precision | Recall | Mean position error | Median height error |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pole | 74 | 74 | 74 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.09 m | 0.10 m |
| tree | 96 | 96 | 96 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.12 m | 0.11 m |
| building | 89 | 88 | 88 | 1.000 | 0.989 | 0.12 m | 0.08 m |

Building heights are the highest point the scanner sees on the facade; for tall buildings close to the street that is below the roof line, so the height error there is a property of the scan, not the model.

## Twin: change detection between two scans

12 streets scanned twice. Between scans one pole is removed, one tree planted and one building gains a storey (+3.2 m); every parked vehicle moves, and must not be reported.

| Labels | Changes found | False alarms | Missed |
|---|---|---|---|
| DGCNN predictions | 36 of 36 | 0 | 0 |
| Ground truth (upper bound) | 36 of 36 | 0 | 0 |

## Model

DGCNN, 130,181 parameters: three EdgeConv layers (k = 16; the first on coordinates, the next two on learned features), global context, per-point classifier. Trained for 15 epochs on 120 streets, best epoch chosen on 8 validation streets. Inputs per point: position in its 20 m block, height above a terrain model, intensity.
